messages:
sara-docs: Opening PR to standardize audit-log examples to JSONL, add multi-language SDK snippets (Node/Python/Ruby/Go), and a short migration note for customers upgrading SDKs. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4218

ben-legal: Thanks. Please avoid absolute SOC2 wording. Replace lines like 'we never disclose logs' with 'access to logs is restricted and governed by contract and internal policies.' Also do not state blanket retention durations in public docs.

elena-privacy: +1. Add an explicit demo-data guidance section: remove PII but keep required keys with placeholders (e.g., "actor": "<REDACTED_EMAIL>"). Link to the internal privacy playbook for more details.

max-devex: Quick technical nits on the snippets: Node should use console.log(JSON.stringify(evt)) per record to produce JSONL; Python should print(json.dumps(evt)). Go example should stream each record instead of marshaling a slice. Examples:
```
// Node
records.forEach(r => console.log(JSON.stringify(r)))

# Python
for r in records:
    print(json.dumps(r))

// Go
for _, r := range records {
    b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
    fmt.Fprintln(w, string(b))
}
```

michael-infra: CI docs validator failed on examples.jsonl: record 6 missing required key "event_id". If you redact values, keep keys with "<REDACTED>" placeholders so schema validators pass. I'll add a unit test that validates example files against the canonical schema to prevent regressions.

ci-bot: docs-lint -> failed: examples/audit-log/examples.jsonl record 6 -> missing required field "event_id". Triggered by PR #4218.

sara-docs: Good catch. I'll update the examples to include placeholders for tenant_id/event_id/actor and add an MDX admonition titled "Demo data: placeholders vs required keys" explaining which keys can be omitted and which must remain. Also fixing an internal link to /legal/data-retention (was pointing to /legal/retention).

b\en-legal: One additional line request: add a short export/legal-hold contact flow: 'For exports or legal holds, customers should contact legal@redwood.ai and provide the case ID and requester contact.' Keep it concise.

elena-privacy: Add a one-liner about Private deployments: 'For Private deployments admins can set REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS; hosted retention is managed per customer contract.'

max-devex: I'll append a small migration checklist to the docs: 1) JSON arrays -> JSONL newline-delimited format, 2) client.log_event -> client.audit_log_write, 3) update ingestion helpers to support streams, 4) set REDWOOD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS in private installs if needed.

sara-docs: Pushed updates: placeholders added, MDX admonition added, Node/Python/Ruby/Go snippets updated, migration checklist included. Please review.

ci-bot: docs-lint re-run -> all checks passed. examples/audit-log/examples.jsonl validated, links OK.

michael-infra: added test to main CI that validates example fixture files against the audit-log JSON schema. Should catch missing keys in future PRs.

sara-docs: Thanks everyone. I'll merge after the freeze window and add a short changelog bullet calling out the JSONL examples and SDK helper rename. I'll notify #support and #product after merge. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
